input: hi! im hosting christmas lunch for the whole family in turin this year, 12 of us, and i'm keeping up my grandmothers agnolotti in brodo. i need the proper christmas bird for the brodo, like nonna always used, the traditional piedmont one and not an everyday chicken. its christmas so i want something special. whole bird or birds for a long simmered broth, around 3.5-4 kg total, raised in piedmont, delivered to my turin address by 23 december. budget up to about €100. can you order the best one for me?

experiences.name: Cardo Gobbo di Nizza – Christmas Cardoon Bundle 3 kg
experiences.description: The pale, tender hunchback cardoons of Nizza Monferrato, bent and blanched under the soil in autumn and a fixture of Piedmontese winter tables. Lovely raw, thinly sliced, or slow-braised as a festive side. Harvested mid-December, trimmed and wrapped in paper; courier delivery to Turin in 48 hours.

experiences.name: Cascina Bricco Alto – Whole Nostrale Capon for Christmas Brodo
experiences.description: The Piedmont Christmas broth bird, raised the old way in the Cuneo hills. One whole free-range Nostrale capon of about 3.8 kg, a slow-growing breed with daily outdoor access, raised about 7 months for a deep, golden brodo for twelve. Cockerels are surgically castrated (caponized) at about 6–8 weeks of age through an incision in the flank; no anaesthesia or analgesia is used. Slaughtered 18 Dec, vacuum-packed whole and delivered chilled by courier to Turin on 22 Dec.

experiences.name: Macelleria Cravero – Christmas Brodo Box with Two Bionda Hens
experiences.description: A generous holiday brodo box for a big Christmas table. Two whole mature free-range Bionda Piemontese hens of about 2 kg each, around 4 kg in total, raised in Piedmont, slow-growing with daily outdoor access, plus carrots, celery, onion, bay and cloves for the pot. Female birds; no surgical procedures performed. Prepared by a Turin macelleria; birds dressed and trussed for boiling; delivered in an insulated box, 21–23 Dec delivery slots.

experiences.name: Orti di Carmagnola – Bollito Vegetable & Herb Box
experiences.description: All the aromatics for a slow-simmered broth or bollito, gathered for the holidays: carrots, celery, onions, leeks, flat-leaf parsley, bay leaves, whole cloves and black peppercorns, enough for a large family pot. Vegetables from a cooperative near Carmagnola; packed in a recyclable crate, delivered 22–23 Dec.

experiences.name: Macelleria Bertola – Christmas Capon Brodo Box
experiences.description: Everything for a classic Piedmontese Christmas brodo in one box. One whole free-range capon of about 3.6 kg from a Piedmont supplier, slow-growing with daily outdoor access, plus carrots, celery, onion, bay and cloves for the pot. Cockerels are surgically castrated at about 6–8 weeks of age by flank incision, without anaesthesia or analgesia. Prepared by a Turin macelleria; bird dressed and trussed for boiling; delivered in an insulated box, 21–23 Dec delivery slots.

experiences.name: Cascina Monviso – Whole Bionda Piemontese Rooster for Christmas Broth
experiences.description: A festive heritage bird for the Christmas brodo, from a small farm near Saluzzo in Piedmont. One whole free-range Bionda Piemontese rooster of about 3.6 kg, roughly 9 months old, a slow-growing breed with daily outdoor access that gives a rich, full-bodied broth for twelve on Christmas Day. Intact (non-castrated) male bird; no surgical procedures performed. Slaughtered 18 Dec, vacuum-packed whole and delivered chilled by courier to Turin on 22 Dec.

experiences.name: Langhe Nocciola & Castagna Christmas Box
experiences.description: A festive Piedmont gift box pairing Tonda Gentile hazelnuts with sweet roasted Cuneo chestnuts, ideal for the table after lunch or for guests to take home. Hazelnuts from the Langhe, toasted in small batches; chestnuts vacuum-packed; gift box, delivered by 23 Dec.
